beats.care: Work on the ORR near KR Puram or Marathahalli? Don't plan around it yet. Trials come months before passengers.
beats.what: Trials are planned from November on the Blue Line's ORR stretch and the Pink Line's underground section. Both may open by May 2027.
beats.why: Track and trains are nearly ready, but signals and platform screen doors must be tested together first.
